title: Gefen: Optimized Stochastic Optimizer
abstract: arXiv:2606.13894v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: AdamW is a default optimizer for deep learning, but its moment states add two parameter-sized buffers to training memory, increasing the cost of large-scale pretraining. We propose Gefen, a memory-efficient optimizer that automatically shares second-moment estimates across parameter blocks and quantizes the first moment using a learned codebook. Gefen reduces AdamW's optimizer memory footprint by up to 8x while maintaining performance, saving 6.5 GiB per billion parameters. Prior work shares second moments across parameters grouped along the Hessian's block-diagonal structure, but relies on hand-specified architectural rules and leaves unexplained why such grouping works. We prove that large mixed Hessian entries constrain the ratio of squared gradients toward one, explaining why shared second moments are accurate when the squared gradients they pool are similar. translated_abstract: AdamW 是深度学习中的默认优化器，但其矩状态会为训练内存增加两个与参数规模相同的缓冲区，从而推高大模型预训练的成本。我们提出 Gefen，一种内存高效的优化器，它能在参数块之间自动共享二阶矩估计，并利用学习到的码本对一阶矩进行量化。Gefen 在保持性能的同时，将 AdamW 的优化器内存占用最多降低 8 倍，每十亿参数可节省 6.5 GiB 内存。先前的工作沿着 Hessian 矩阵的块对角结构对参数分组并共享二阶矩，但依赖人工指定的架构规则，且未能解释这种分组为何有效。我们证明了较大的 Hessian 非对角（混合）元素会将平方梯度之比约束到趋近于 1，从而解释了当共享二阶矩所汇聚的平方梯度彼此相近时，这些共享估计为何依然准确。这一方法无需实际计算 Hessian 矩阵：其块结构是继承而来的。
tldr: Gefen 通过在参数块间自动共享二阶矩估计并用学习到的码本量化一阶矩，将 AdamW 的优化器内存占用最多降低 8 倍（每十亿参数节省 6.5 GiB），同时从理论上解释了二阶矩共享有效的原因。
en_tdlr: Gefen automatically shares second-moment estimates across parameter blocks and quantizes first moments with a learned codebook, reducing AdamW's optimizer memory by up to 8x (saving 6.5 GiB per billion parameters) while maintaining performance and theoretically explaining why second-moment sharing works.
